entities.summary: The Jome Mosque, also known as the Aradabil Jame' (Jameh) Mosque and as the Jame' Mosque, is a former Shi'ite Friday mosque, now in partial ruins, located in Ardabil, in the Ardabil province of Iran. The mosque was built during the Seljuk era.
